title: "PFS-like survival from first cfDNA draw by first TFx among patients with TFx ≥ 3%_subtype"
output: html_document
date: "2026-07-01"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# PFS Analysis 1 subgroup KM plots
# First available cfDNA blood draw TFx vs PFS-like survival
# Subgroups:
#   HR+ HER2-
#   HR+ HER2+
#   HR- HER2-
#   HR- HER2+
#
# Locked KM style:
# CI + censor marks + one number-at-risk table + no grid
# ============================================================

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# ----------------------------
# Paths
# ----------------------------
pfs1_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/AURORA/Survival/PFS_Analysis1_first_available_draw"

input_file <- file.path(
  pfs1_dir,
  "PFS1_first_available_draw_per_patient.csv"
)

out_dir <- file.path(
  pfs1_dir,
  "PFS1_receptor_subgroup_KM"
)

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

summary_out <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "PFS1_receptor_subgroup_KM_summary.csv"
)

cat("Input file:\n", input_file, "\n\n")
cat("Output directory:\n", out_dir, "\n\n")

# ----------------------------
# Read data
# ----------------------------
df <- read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Rows in input:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Columns:\n")
print(colnames(df))

# ----------------------------
# Required columns
# ----------------------------
required_cols <- c(
  "patient_id_clean",
  "first_TFx",
  "PFS_time_from_first_draw",
  "PFS_time_from_first_draw_months",
  "PFS_event_from_first_draw",
  "Subgroups"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(df))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
      "\nPlease make sure these columns are present in PFS1_first_available_draw_per_patient.csv."
    )
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# Helper functions
# ----------------------------
format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("p = NA")
  } else if (p < 0.001) {
    return("p < 0.001")
  } else {
    return(paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
  }
}

safe_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_replace_all("\\+", "pos") %>%
    str_replace_all("-", "neg") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "")
}

# ----------------------------
# Clean and prepare data
# ----------------------------

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id_clean = as.character(patient_id_clean),

    first_TFx = as.numeric(first_TFx),
    PFS_time_from_first_draw = as.numeric(PFS_time_from_first_draw),
    PFS_time_from_first_draw_months = as.numeric(PFS_time_from_first_draw_months),
    PFS_event_from_first_draw = as.numeric(PFS_event_from_first_draw),

    receptor_subtype = str_squish(as.character(Subgroups)),

    receptor_subtype = factor(
      receptor_subtype,
      levels = c("HR+ HER2-", "HR+ HER2+", "HR- HER2-", "HR- HER2+")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(patient_id_clean),
    !is.na(first_TFx),
    !is.na(PFS_time_from_first_draw_months),
    !is.na(PFS_event_from_first_draw),
    PFS_time_from_first_draw_months > 0,
    !is.na(receptor_subtype)
  )

cat("\n========== Clean PFS1 receptor-subgroup cohort ==========\n")
cat("Patients:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Events:", sum(df$PFS_event_from_first_draw == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Censored:", sum(df$PFS_event_from_first_draw == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

cat("Subtype counts:\n")
print(table(df$receptor_subtype, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nSubtype events:\n")
print(table(df$receptor_subtype, df$PFS_event_from_first_draw, useNA = "ifany"))

# ----------------------------
# Output patient-level subtype assignment
# ----------------------------
# ----------------------------
# Output patient-level subtype assignment
# ----------------------------
subtype_assignment_out <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "PFS1_patient_receptor_subtype_assignment.csv"
)

df %>%
  select(
    patient_id_clean,
    first_TFx,
    Subgroups,
    receptor_subtype,
    PFS_time_from_first_draw,
    PFS_time_from_first_draw_months,
    PFS_event_from_first_draw
  ) %>%
  write_csv(subtype_assignment_out)

cat("\nSaved receptor subtype assignment:\n", subtype_assignment_out, "\n")

# ----------------------------
# Loop through subgroups
# ----------------------------
subtypes <- c("HR+ HER2-", "HR+ HER2+", "HR- HER2-", "HR- HER2+")

summary_list <- list()

for (subtype in subtypes) {
  
  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("Running subtype:", subtype, "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")
  
  sub_df <- df %>%
    filter(receptor_subtype == subtype) %>%
    droplevels()
  
  n_sub <- nrow(sub_df)
  n_events <- sum(sub_df$PFS_event_from_first_draw == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_censored <- sum(sub_df$PFS_event_from_first_draw == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat("Patients:", n_sub, "\n")
  cat("Events:", n_events, "\n")
  cat("Censored:", n_censored, "\n")
  
  if (n_sub < 6) {
    cat("Skipping", subtype, ": too few patients.\n")
    
    summary_list[[subtype]] <- data.frame(
      receptor_subtype = subtype,
      status = "Skipped: too few patients",
      n_patients = n_sub,
      n_events = n_events,
      n_censored = n_censored,
      TFx_cutpoint = NA_real_,
      low_n = NA_integer_,
      low_events = NA_integer_,
      high_n = NA_integer_,
      high_events = NA_integer_,
      logrank_p_value = NA_real_
    )
    
    next
  }
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Subtype-specific median TFx cutpoint
  # ----------------------------
  subtype_tfx_cut <- median(sub_df$first_TFx, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  sub_df <- sub_df %>%
    mutate(
      first_TFx_group_subtype = ifelse(
        first_TFx >= subtype_tfx_cut,
        "High first TFx",
        "Low first TFx"
      ),
      first_TFx_group_subtype = factor(
        first_TFx_group_subtype,
        levels = c("Low first TFx", "High first TFx")
      )
    )
  
  cat("Subtype-specific median TFx cutpoint:", round(subtype_tfx_cut, 4), "%\n")
  cat("TFx group counts:\n")
  print(table(sub_df$first_TFx_group_subtype))
  
  if (length(unique(sub_df$first_TFx_group_subtype)) < 2) {
    cat("Skipping", subtype, ": only one TFx group present.\n")
    
    summary_list[[subtype]] <- data.frame(
      receptor_subtype = subtype,
      status = "Skipped: only one TFx group",
      n_patients = n_sub,
      n_events = n_events,
      n_censored = n_censored,
      TFx_cutpoint = subtype_tfx_cut,
      low_n = sum(sub_df$first_TFx_group_subtype == "Low first TFx"),
      low_events = sum(sub_df$first_TFx_group_subtype == "Low first TFx" &
                         sub_df$PFS_event_from_first_draw == 1),
      high_n = sum(sub_df$first_TFx_group_subtype == "High first TFx"),
      high_events = sum(sub_df$first_TFx_group_subtype == "High first TFx" &
                          sub_df$PFS_event_from_first_draw == 1),
      logrank_p_value = NA_real_
    )
    
    next
  }
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Survival fit
  # ----------------------------
  fit <- survfit(
    Surv(PFS_time_from_first_draw_months, PFS_event_from_first_draw) ~ first_TFx_group_subtype,
    data = sub_df
  )
  
  # ----------------------------
# Median PFS months by TFx group
# ----------------------------
median_tbl <- surv_median(fit) %>%
  mutate(
    group_clean = case_when(
      str_detect(strata, "Low first TFx") ~ "Low first TFx",
      str_detect(strata, "High first TFx") ~ "High first TFx",
      TRUE ~ strata
    )
  )

low_median_months <- median_tbl %>%
  filter(group_clean == "Low first TFx") %>%
  pull(median)

low_median_lower_95CI <- median_tbl %>%
  filter(group_clean == "Low first TFx") %>%
  pull(lower)

low_median_upper_95CI <- median_tbl %>%
  filter(group_clean == "Low first TFx") %>%
  pull(upper)

high_median_months <- median_tbl %>%
  filter(group_clean == "High first TFx") %>%
  pull(median)

high_median_lower_95CI <- median_tbl %>%
  filter(group_clean == "High first TFx") %>%
  pull(lower)

high_median_upper_95CI <- median_tbl %>%
  filter(group_clean == "High first TFx") %>%
  pull(upper)

# If median is not reached, keep as NA
low_median_months <- ifelse(length(low_median_months) == 0, NA_real_, low_median_months)
low_median_lower_95CI <- ifelse(length(low_median_lower_95CI) == 0, NA_real_, low_median_lower_95CI)
low_median_upper_95CI <- ifelse(length(low_median_upper_95CI) == 0, NA_real_, low_median_upper_95CI)

high_median_months <- ifelse(length(high_median_months) == 0, NA_real_, high_median_months)
high_median_lower_95CI <- ifelse(length(high_median_lower_95CI) == 0, NA_real_, high_median_lower_95CI)
high_median_upper_95CI <- ifelse(length(high_median_upper_95CI) == 0, NA_real_, high_median_upper_95CI)

  # ----------------------------
  # Log-rank p-value
  # ----------------------------
  lr <- survdiff(
    Surv(PFS_time_from_first_draw_months, PFS_event_from_first_draw) ~ first_TFx_group_subtype,
    data = sub_df
  )
  
  p_val <- 1 - pchisq(lr$chisq, df = length(lr$n) - 1)
  p_label <- format_p(p_val)
  
  annot_text <- paste0(
    "Log-rank ", p_label, "\n",
    "Median TFx cutpoint = ", round(subtype_tfx_cut, 2), "%"
  )
  
  cat("Log-rank p-value:", p_val, "\n")
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Legend labels
  # ----------------------------
  low_n <- sum(sub_df$first_TFx_group_subtype == "Low first TFx")
  low_events <- sum(
    sub_df$first_TFx_group_subtype == "Low first TFx" &
      sub_df$PFS_event_from_first_draw == 1
  )
  
  high_n <- sum(sub_df$first_TFx_group_subtype == "High first TFx")
  high_events <- sum(
    sub_df$first_TFx_group_subtype == "High first TFx" &
      sub_df$PFS_event_from_first_draw == 1
  )
  
  legend_labs <- c(
    paste0("Low first TFx (n=", low_n, ", events=", low_events, ")"),
    paste0("High first TFx (n=", high_n, ", events=", high_events, ")")
  )
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Axis settings
  # ----------------------------
  x_max <- 72
  break_by <- 12
  
  annot_x <- x_max * 0.94
  annot_y <- 0.97
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Plot
  # ----------------------------
  p <- ggsurvplot(
    fit,
    data = sub_df,
    
    # Main KM curve
    conf.int = TRUE,
    conf.int.alpha = 0.22,
    censor = TRUE,
    censor.shape = 3,
    censor.size = 3.2,
    size = 1.15,
    
    # Single bottom number-at-risk table
    risk.table = TRUE,
    risk.table.title = "Number at risk",
    risk.table.height = 0.24,
    risk.table.y.text = TRUE,
    risk.table.y.text.col = TRUE,
    tables.theme = theme_cleantable(base_size = 12),
    
    # Labels
    title = paste0("PFS-like survival from first cfDNA draw: ", subtype),
    xlab = "Time from first cfDNA blood draw to progression/death/censor (months)",
    ylab = "Progression/death-free probability",
    
    # Axis
    break.time.by = break_by,
    xlim = c(0, x_max),
    ylim = c(0, 1.05),
    
    # Legend
    legend.title = "First-draw TFx group",
    legend.labs = legend_labs,
    legend = "top",
    
    # Colors
    palette = c("#1E88E5", "#E74C3C"),
    
    # Manual p-value annotation
    pval = FALSE,
    
    # Base theme
    ggtheme = theme_classic(base_size = 15)
  )
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Clean main KM plot
  # ----------------------------
  p$plot <- p$plot +
    annotate(
      "label",
      x = annot_x,
      y = annot_y,
      label = annot_text,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.4,
      label.size = 0.25,
      fill = "white",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 17,
        margin = margin(t = 10, b = 18)
      ),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.box.margin = margin(b = 8),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      
      # Locked style: no grid lines
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      
      plot.margin = margin(t = 18, r = 15, b = 5, l = 15)
    )
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Clean bottom number-at-risk table
  # ----------------------------
  p$table <- p$table +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
      
      # Locked style: no grid lines
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      
      plot.margin = margin(t = 4, r = 15, b = 8, l = 15)
    )
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Save plot
  # ----------------------------
  subtype_file <- safe_name(subtype)
  
  out_png <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0("PFS1_KM_first_TFx_", subtype_file, ".png")
  )
  
  out_pdf <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0("PFS1_KM_first_TFx_", subtype_file, ".pdf")
  )
  
  png(
    filename = out_png,
    width = 11,
    height = 8.3,
    units = "in",
    res = 300
  )
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  pdf(
    file = out_pdf,
    width = 11,
    height = 8.3
  )
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  cat("Saved:\n")
  cat(out_png, "\n")
  cat(out_pdf, "\n")
  
  # ----------------------------
  # ----------------------------
  # Store summary
  # ----------------------------
  summary_list[[subtype]] <- data.frame(
    receptor_subtype = subtype,
    status = "Plotted",
    n_patients = n_sub,
    n_events = n_events,
    n_censored = n_censored,
    TFx_cutpoint = subtype_tfx_cut,

    low_n = low_n,
    low_events = low_events,
    low_median_PFS_months = low_median_months,
    low_median_PFS_lower_95CI = low_median_lower_95CI,
    low_median_PFS_upper_95CI = low_median_upper_95CI,

    high_n = high_n,
    high_events = high_events,
    high_median_PFS_months = high_median_months,
    high_median_PFS_lower_95CI = high_median_lower_95CI,
    high_median_PFS_upper_95CI = high_median_upper_95CI,

    logrank_p_value = p_val
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# Save summary across subgroups
# ----------------------------
subgroup_summary <- bind_rows(summary_list)

write_csv(subgroup_summary, summary_out)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Saved receptor subgroup KM summary:\n")
cat(summary_out, "\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

print(subgroup_summary)
```
